entries.50b8933aeedeef78: It manufactures engine compressors and engine generators for use at construction sites, and motor compressors and emergency generators for factory equipment. It is stated that research and development is advancing toward engine compressors equipped with high-efficiency air ends that adopt a new tooth profile, engine generators running on biofuel, and test machines fuelled by hydrogen.
entries.54974052228b31fd: This reportable segment manufactures and sells engine compressors, engine generators, aerial work platforms and others, and is the larger of the 2 reportable segments by net sales to external customers. Net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥44,552 million (up 1.0% year on year), and segment profit was ¥7,043 million (up 11.9%); both were record highs. The securities report gives the breakdown of net sales as domestic construction machinery ¥19,626 million (down 3.6%) and overseas construction machinery ¥24,925 million (up 4.8%). In Japan, engine generators grew on demand from wide-area rental companies, while shipments of engine compressors were sluggish as construction plans stalled due to labor shortages and soaring raw material prices. Overseas, shipments of engine compressors to North America grew significantly and engine generators recovered, offsetting weakness in Asia, including China, according to the securities report. The company, Ienu Shisutemu Co., Ltd., Fandorī Co., Ltd., AIRMAN USA CORPORATION and affiliate Shanghai Fukusei Airman Kiden Co., Ltd. manufacture and sell the products, and Ēesushī Co., Ltd., HOKUETSU INDUSTRIES EUROPE B.V. and AIRMAN ASIA SDN.BHD. handle sales.
entries.5a4b55e48c5f94b9: Construction machinery is sold mainly to rental companies in Japan and overseas, and in North America transactions with large wide-area rental companies through sales agents are expanding. The annual securities report states that the overseas revenue ratio for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was 44.8%. Industrial machinery is sold mainly to domestic customers, and OEM supply to Kobelco Compressors Corporation also contributed to results. Receivables from major sales agents in North America are items that the annual securities report classifies as doubtful receivables and assesses individually for recoverability; no allowance for doubtful accounts was recorded at the end of the fiscal year ended March 2026.
entries.5a8a4524880970a7: This reportable segment manufactures and sells motor compressors, emergency generators and others. Net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥11,052 million (up 8.1%), and segment profit was ¥2,221 million (up 22.3%); both were record highs. The securities report says that while domestic capital investment sentiment remained solid, OEM supply of motor compressors to Kobelco Compressors Corporation contributed to results, and sales of compressor bodies sold externally, manually operated aerial work platforms, and parts and services also increased. On the profit side, the company cites the pass-through of motor compressor price increases and an increase in higher-margin products sold externally. The company and Fandorī Co., Ltd. manufacture and sell the products, and Ēesushī Co., Ltd. handles sales. In December 2025, the company launched generators for refrigerated and frozen containers (reefer containers) and aims to newly enter the cold chain industry.
entries.618d2053b767094a: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥55,604 million (up 2.3% year on year), a record high. The Construction Machinery Business recorded ¥44,552 million (up 1.0%), and the Industrial Machinery Business ¥11,052 million (up 8.1%). Domestic construction machinery decreased 3.6% due to labour shortages and other factors, while overseas construction machinery increased 4.8% and domestic industrial machinery increased 8.1%. The annual securities report states that overseas transactions are mainly denominated in US dollars and euros and are readily affected directly by fluctuations in currency exchange rates.
entries.6b997f25a95a646b: Operating profit for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥7,184 million (up 11.2% year on year), ordinary profit was ¥8,014 million (up 17.4%), and profit attributable to owners of parent was ¥5,596 million (up 17.4%), all record highs. The annual securities report states that the company passed on various cost increases through selling prices, and that higher sales to North America and a weak yen trend increased profit. Fluctuations in prices of raw materials such as iron, copper and crude oil, and US tariffs, are cited as factors affecting profit. Net cash used in operating activities was ¥2,377 million (net cash provided of ¥3,950 million in the same period of the previous year).

entries.f9aba631b9765481: The [[term:annual-securities-report|annual securities report]] states that the group (the company, six subsidiaries and one affiliate accounted for by the equity method) manufactures and sells construction and industrial machinery, such as compressors, generators and vehicle-type construction machinery, and conducts business in two reportable segments: the “Construction Machinery Business” and the “Industrial Machinery Business.” The Construction Machinery Business mainly offers engine compressors, engine generators and aerial work platforms, and the Industrial Machinery Business mainly offers motor compressors and emergency generators. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥55,604 million (up 2.3% year on year), broken down into ¥19,626 million from domestic construction machinery, ¥24,925 million from overseas construction machinery and ¥11,052 million from domestic industrial machinery. The annual securities report states that, while domestic sales stagnated, sales through overseas construction machinery channels, centred on strong sales in North America, increased, and consolidated revenue reached a record high. Products are mostly made to stock, and the description of order results is omitted.
entries.fb16447342ce040b: The company, six consolidated subsidiaries and one equity-method affiliate make up the group. Manufacturing and sales are handled by the company, EN System Co., Ltd., Fandorī Co., Ltd., AIRMAN USA CORPORATION and others, while sales are handled by ASC Co., Ltd., HOKUETSU INDUSTRIES EUROPE B.V., AIRMAN ASIA SDN.BHD. and others. EN System Co., Ltd. was merged into the company (absorbed) effective April 1, 2026.
